sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Roof Rails 2021! lies its simple yet engaging gameplay mechanics. The game is all about navigating a stickman through a series of obstacles, collecting jewels, and extending his stick to reach the next roof. The stickman is automatically moving forward, and all you need to do is swipe left and right on your keyboard to control his movement.

The goal is to reach the end of each level by picking up a piece of stick that's falling down the road, stretching the stick, or collecting jewels. The longer your stick, the easier it is to capture the stage, and the more diamonds you'll get at the end of the game. Diamonds are the game's currency, and you can use them to buy new skins, which can add a personal touch to your stickman.

One of the key aspects of Roof Rails 2021! is its auto-running feature. The stickman is always moving forward, which means you need to time your swipes perfectly to avoid obstacles. This adds an extra layer of challenge to the game, making it more exciting and engaging.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Roof Rails 2021! are simple yet effective, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels.
